title: Barre VT Home Energy Rebates 2026: Oil Homes, Renters and Efficiency Vermont
desc: Barre, Vermont home rebates for 2026: Efficiency Vermont and Green Mountain Power heat pump, weatherization, battery and EV offers for a city that is 58% oil-heated and half renters.
h1: Home Energy Rebates in Barre, Vermont
lead: Barre is more oil-dependent and more evenly split between owners and renters than Montpelier next door. The rebates are the same, but the fit is not: who owns the building matters as much as what heats it.
cards_heading: The rebates that matter most in Barre
cards_intro: We re-read Efficiency Vermont's rebate list and Green Mountain Power's program pages on October 5, 2026. Barre is Green Mountain Power territory. Amounts are maximums.

cards.title: Heat pump
cards.note: Efficiency Vermont instant discounts by system type, plus up to $600 for controls. Green Mountain Power adds $2,000 per condenser for households at or under 80% of area median income ($91,200 for four in Washington County).

cards.title: Weatherization
cards.note: 75% of qualifying insulation and air sealing, higher cap if income-eligible, while funding lasts.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: Efficiency Vermont, through the Green Mountain Power page for your area.

cards.title: Home battery
cards.note: Green Mountain Power's Bring Your Own Device program pays by the kW of storage you share at peaks, with $100 more per kW for some solar retrofits.

cards.title: Electric vehicle and charger
cards.note: Green Mountain Power: up to $2,500 for an all-electric vehicle, and up to $650 toward a home charger installation if you buy or lease in 2026.

cards.title: Appliances
cards.note: Efficiency Vermont rebates on thermostats, dryers, dehumidifiers and stoves, and Green Mountain Power's $200 induction cooktop rebate.

after_cards: Statewide pages cover solar, batteries, EV chargers, appliances and thermostats and windows and doors.
sections: The Census Bureau's 2020 to 2024 American Community Survey counts 4,094 occupied homes. 2,385 (58%) heat mainly with oil or kerosene, 627 (15%) with propane, 569 (14%) with electricity, 201 (5%) with piped gas and 175 (4%) with wood. 2,012 of 4,335 housing units (46%) were built in 1939 or earlier.
An even split between owners and renters

2,062 households own and 2,032 rent. 1,426 units are in two-, three- and four-unit buildings and 883 in larger ones. Efficiency Vermont says rental property owners are not eligible for the heat pump income bonus. A tenant who pays for heat and a landlord who owns the building often need to agree before anything is installed.

Barre and Montpelier share Green Mountain Power, Washington County's income limits and an average January low of -11.9°C. Barre has a higher oil share (58% against 45%) and a higher pre-1940 share (46% against 38%). Its record low between 2015 and 2024 was -30.9°C.

Green Mountain Power's vehicle rebates apply through December 31, 2026, and its induction cooktop rebate covers purchases through the same date. Efficiency Vermont's weatherization offer, effective July 1, 2026, lasts while funding lasts, and its income limits changed on July 1, 2026. If you checked your eligibility before July, check again.

Efficiency Vermont lists free appliances, products and services for income-qualified Vermonters, a free Weatherization Assistance Program through a partner and a free Virtual Home Energy Visit. With half of Barre's households renting and oil as the main fuel for most, a free visit is an easy way for a tenant or a small landlord to find out whether the building is a good candidate for the paid programs. We did not read the income limits, so check the program pages.
What we did not verify for Barre

We did not find a Barre city rebate, a Barre-specific utility incentive or a verified local installer count beyond the contractors on the heat pump page. We also did not verify water heating fuel for Barre homes, which the Census does not count. If you know of a local program we missed, tell us through our contact page and we will read it.
faq: Green Mountain Power, per our verified utility list. Efficiency Vermont's statewide offers apply too.
What is the income limit for the $2,000 heat pump rebate?
$91,200 for a household of four in Washington County.
I rent in Barre. What can I do?
Ask your landlord about weatherization and heat pump rebates. Small DIY jobs earn $100 from Efficiency Vermont, and free services exist for income-qualified households.
Is there a Barre city rebate?
We did not find one. The state and Green Mountain Power offers are the ones we verified.
Can I get an EV rebate in Barre?
Green Mountain Power pays up to $2,500 on an all-electric vehicle purchased or leased through December 31, 2026.
